body:
I'll start by reading the CONTRACT.md and exploring the captured sources.

Now let me explore the three JavaScript repos in detail.

Let me read the key grammY source files with line numbers.

Now let me gather Telegraf source citations.

Now let me gather GramIO source citations.

I have the material. Let me verify every line I plan to cite with sed before writing.

The file is too long; let me tighten it to the required byte range.

Now writing the Telegraf chapter.

The edit landed incorrectly; let me inspect and repair the file.

Now writing the GramIO chapter.

Let me verify all citations resolve and check final structure and sizes.

Completed the three assigned files:

- `11-js-grammy.md` — 6,921 bytes, 10 Sources entries
- `12-js-telegraf.md` — 7,191 bytes, 9 Sources entries
- `13-js-gramio-and-typed.md` — 7,062 bytes, 10 Sources entries

All have the required `# NN - Title` first line and `## Sources` last section. Every one of the 227 `path:line` citations was checked with `sed` against the pinned clones (and `bots/samples.md` against the captured official page); all resolve, with paths lacking the `repos/` prefix and full GitHub blob URLs using the pinned short SHAs (`e8b3b1b`, `1386cc4`, `a648763`) in Sources. No other files were written.

Notes: grammY's conversations plugin and `@grammyjs/runner` are outside the core clone and are explicitly marked `not verified`; `typescript-telegram-bot-api` has no captured clone, so it is cited only from the official samples page and marked `not verified` beyond that listing.
